schema.name: __drizzle_migrations
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "__drizzle_migrations" ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, hash text NOT NULL, created_at numeric )

schema.name: alert_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `alert_events` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`rule_id` text NOT NULL,
	`message` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`sent_at` integer, `occurrence_key` text, `payload` text, `rule_revision` integer,
	FOREIGN KEY (`rule_id`) REFERENCES `alert_rules`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

schema.name: alert_events_occurrence_idx
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `alert_events_occurrence_idx` ON `alert_events` (`occurrence_key`)

schema.name: alert_events_rule_time_idx
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX `alert_events_rule_time_idx` ON `alert_events` (`rule_id`,`created_at`)

schema.name: alert_rules
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `alert_rules` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`ins_code` text NOT NULL,
	`type` text NOT NULL,
	`threshold_percent` real,
	`window_minutes` integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
	`minimum_baseline_volume` integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
	`cooldown_seconds` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`enabled` integer DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	`armed` integer DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	`last_triggered_at` integer,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL, `owner_id` text REFERENCES users(telegram_user_id), `definition` text, `revision` integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, `channel_id` text REFERENCES telegram_channels(channel_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (`ins_code`) REFERENCES `symbols`(`ins_code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	CONSTRAINT "alert_rule_type" CHECK("alert_rules"."type" IN ('BUY_QUEUE_DROP_PERCENT', 'SELL_QUEUE_DROP_PERCENT', 'BUY_QUEUE_DISAPPEARED', 'SELL_QUEUE_DISAPPEARED')),
	CONSTRAINT "alert_rule_threshold" CHECK(("alert_rules"."type" NOT IN ('BUY_QUEUE_DROP_PERCENT', 'SELL_QUEUE_DROP_PERCENT')) OR ("alert_rules"."threshold_percent" IS NOT NULL AND "alert_rules"."threshold_percent" > 0 AND "alert_rules"."threshold_percent" <= 100)),
	CONSTRAINT "alert_rule_window" CHECK("alert_rules"."window_minutes" IN (1, 5)),
	CONSTRAINT "alert_rule_baseline" CHECK("alert_rules"."minimum_baseline_volume" > 0),
	CONSTRAINT "alert_rule_cooldown" CHECK("alert_rules"."cooldown_seconds" >= 0)
)

schema.name: alert_rules_channel_idx
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX `alert_rules_channel_idx` ON `alert_rules` (`channel_id`,`enabled`)

schema.name: alert_rules_enabled_symbol_idx
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX `alert_rules_enabled_symbol_idx` ON `alert_rules` (`enabled`,`ins_code`)

schema.name: alert_rules_owner_symbol_idx
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX `alert_rules_owner_symbol_idx` ON `alert_rules` (`owner_id`,`ins_code`)

schema.name: alert_states
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `alert_states` (
	`rule_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`session_id` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	`last_evaluated_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`last_triggered_at` integer,
	`baseline_volume` integer, `recovery_data` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`rule_id`) REFERENCES `alert_rules`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

schema.name: application_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `application_state` (
	`key` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`value` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL
)

schema.name: notification_outbox
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `notification_outbox` (
	`event_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
	`attempts` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`next_attempt_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`lease_until` integer,
	`lease_token` text,
	`error_code` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`event_id`) REFERENCES `alert_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

schema.name: notification_outbox_due_idx
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX `notification_outbox_due_idx` ON `notification_outbox` (`status`,`next_attempt_at`)

schema.name: queue_snapshots
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `queue_snapshots` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`ins_code` text NOT NULL,
	`timestamp` integer NOT NULL,
	`queue_type` text NOT NULL,
	`volume` integer NOT NULL,
	`price` real,
	`order_count` integer NOT NULL, `collected_at` integer, `symbol` text, `session_id` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`ins_code`) REFERENCES `symbols`(`ins_code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	CONSTRAINT "snapshot_queue_type" CHECK("queue_snapshots"."queue_type" IN ('buy', 'sell', 'none')),
	CONSTRAINT "snapshot_quantities" CHECK("queue_snapshots"."volume" >= 0 AND "queue_snapshots"."order_count" >= 0),
	CONSTRAINT "snapshot_price" CHECK("queue_snapshots"."price" IS NULL OR "queue_snapshots"."price" > 0)
)

schema.name: queue_snapshots_retention_idx
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX `queue_snapshots_retention_idx` ON `queue_snapshots` (`timestamp`)

schema.name: queue_snapshots_symbol_time_idx
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `queue_snapshots_symbol_time_idx` ON `queue_snapshots` (`ins_code`,`timestamp`)

schema.name: symbols
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `symbols` (
	`ins_code` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`symbol` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL
)

schema.name: telegram_channels
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `telegram_channels` (
	`channel_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`title` text DEFAULT 'کانال تنظیم‌شده' NOT NULL,
	`can_post` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	`checked_at` integer,
	`permission_error` text
)

schema.name: users
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
	`telegram_user_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`private_chat_id` text NOT NULL,
	`notifications_enabled` integer DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL
)

schema.name: watchlists
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `watchlists` (
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`ins_code` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`user_id`, `ins_code`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`telegram_user_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`ins_code`) REFERENCES `symbols`(`ins_code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

schema.name: watchlists_symbol_idx
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX `watchlists_symbol_idx` ON `watchlists` (`ins_code`)
